title: Debug: the title-izer that misbehaves
prompt: `titleCase` should capitalize the first letter of EVERY word and lower the rest: `titleCase("the JAVA tutorial")` is `"The Java Tutorial"`. The version below drops words and keeps wrong case — find both bugs (loop boundary and char handling) and fix them.

tests.name: correct title casing
tests.hint: Capitalize word.substring(0,1).toUpperCase() + rest.toLowerCase(); join with spaces.
